facts.statement: A community party event was held in the Singing Crystal Mines on Server 1 on Thursday September 9, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America).
facts.quote: Thursday September 9th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: A second run of the Singing Crystal Mine party was held on Friday September 10, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday September 10th, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

facts.statement: Players were invited to bring mining gear, boomboxes and dancing shoes to the party, which would run until Therin kicked them out.
facts.quote: Bring your mining gear, boomboxes and dancing shoes and we’ll party until Therin kicks us out.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement: a Singing Crystal Mine party held in the Singing Crystal Mines on Server 1, on Thursday September 9, 2010 (US/Latin America time) and Friday September 10, 2010 (UK/Europe time). The page also explains how players find community events through the Game Guide calendar and its GO button teleport.
